description: This Java class defines a Fragment (LogFragment) that contains a custom LogView for displaying log messages within an Android app. It manages view inflation, layout setup, and automatically scrolls to the bottom when new log entries are added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that hosts a LogView inside a ScrollView, providing log display capabilities with automatic scrolling and layout configuration.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, typefaces, padding, and gravity, then returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher on LogView to auto-scroll when text changes, and returns the main view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
